name: Ted & Amy's 93Q Christmas Spectacular
when_note: Live bands play from 10:20 am to about 1 pm, and the activities run for the full three hours.
paras: Destiny USA hosts Ted & Amy's 93Q Christmas Spectacular on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 am to 1 pm in The Canyon. The mall calls it a free day of holiday fun for the whole family.

Kids get a free toy at Santa's Workshop while supplies last, and can make ornaments, play reindeer games and enter a coloring contest. Local bands perform holiday music, and there is a free photo booth.
tip: Toys are limited, so go early to get one at Santa's Workshop before the bands start playing.
